# ankra_ai_review_repository (Resource)

One repository's AI review rule on a source-control binding, overriding the binding's settings. The counterpart of `ankra org ai-review repos set`; destroy reverts the repository to the binding's settings like `ankra org ai-review repos unset`. Changes need organisation admin.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_ai_review_repository" "portal" {
  scm_provider        = "github"
  binding_external_id = "48151623"
  repo_full_name      = "acme/portal"
  ai_review           = true
  mention_replies     = true
  pr_previews         = false
  review_drafts       = true
  max_reviews_per_pr  = 3
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ai_review` (Boolean) Run the AI review on the repository's pull requests.
- `binding_external_id` (String) The binding's external id (a GitHub App installation id, for example), as `ankra org ai-review repos list` shows it.
- `mention_replies` (Boolean) Answer @mentions on the repository.
- `pr_previews` (Boolean) Build pull request previews for the repository.
- `repo_full_name` (String) Repository path, `owner/name` (or a GitLab group path). The platform stores it lowercased.
- `scm_provider` (String) Source-control provider of the binding, such as `github`, `gitlab` or `bitbucket`.

### Optional

- `max_reviews_per_pr` (Number) Cap on automatic reviews per pull request; `0` is no cap. Unset keeps what the platform holds.
- `review_drafts` (Boolean) Review draft pull requests automatically too. Unset keeps what the platform holds.
- `review_model` (String) Model catalogue key reviews run on. Unset inherits the binding's model.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<scm_provider>/<binding_external_id>/<repo_full_name>`, with the repository as the platform stores it (lowercased).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Repository rules are imported by "<scm_provider>/<binding_external_id>/<repo_full_name>".
terraform import ankra_ai_review_repository.portal github/48151623/acme/portal
```
